title: Priority change priority-change.kp.architecture-compression
summary: User accepted a convergence phase before further expansion: compress project memory and language, prune rejected product representations, retire compatibility through caller migrations, improve governed LLM generation, then pressure TypeScript and Python before selecting a Public Web v0 projection.
